opening.argument: The visible promotion presents Roomi City as a real-estate offer: it advertises residential and commercial plots, gives a starting booking amount, and provides a contact for booking details. The claim of high capital gains makes the offer promotional, but the available evidence does not establish that the claim is false or deceptive. It also shows no completed transaction or loss. The supplied speech refers to winning a one-hand race, a subject unrelated to the property promotion; its connection to the sampled video is unclear and does not change what the visible offer shows. On this record, the booking request remains part of an ordinary property advertisement, not proof of a fraudulent outcome.
